title: A Crown for the Garden
premise: Lena Sandoval, a debt-bound scribe in the Guild of Impossible Things, discovers their own name and tonight's date inked in a century-old prophecy book, revealing that the guild's founder sold their soul to the court beneath the mountain to buy the guild's survival. Hunted by the guild's enforcers who need the debt paid in full, Lena descends with the last dragon, Emberkin, whose dying fire is the only thing that can burn open the court's gates. In the mountain's depths they learn the soul was never truly sold—only pawned—and that justice there is bartered, not decreed. By trading their own invisibility for the founder's freedom, Lena wins the soul back as the dragon-fire gutters out, returns home no longer bound by debt but bound instead to people who finally see them.
about_author: Cyrus Lockridge is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloging ledgers of defunct merchant guilds before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about paperwork, debts, and the quiet people history forgets to record.

chapters.title: The Ledger Opens Both Ways
chapters.summary: POV: Lena Sandoval. While balancing the guild's accounts at midnight, Lena finds their name and today's date written in a sealed prophecy book from a century past, alongside a debt of one soul owed to the court beneath the mountain. When guild enforcers arrive asking questions, Lena flees with the book. Emotional beat: terror and vertigo—the invisible life they built dissolving overnight.

chapters.title: What the Fire Remembers
chapters.summary: POV: Lena, alternating with Emberkin the dragon. Hiding in the ash-fields, Lena bargains with Emberkin, the last dragon, whose guttering flame can unseal the mountain's gates but who demands the truth of the prophecy in exchange. They learn the founder pawned a soul—not sold it—and that the guild has been paying interest in stolen memories for decades. Emotional beat: reluctant alliance; belonging offered by an outcast to an outcast.

chapters.title: Justice Is a Bargain
chapters.summary: POV: Lena. Descending through Emberkin's failing fire, Lena reaches the court beneath the mountain, where judgments are bought and the founder's soul sits in escrow. The guild's enforcers catch up, offering to spare Lena if they let the debt stand. Instead Lena invokes the court's oldest law: any soul may be ransomed by an equal price freely given. Emotional beat: climax—Lena stakes their own invisibility, the one thing they treasured, on the scales.

chapters.title: A Crown for the Garden
chapters.summary: POV: Lena. The ransom accepted, the founder's soul returns even as Emberkin's fire dies, its final breath crowning the mountain's garden gate with living bloom. Above ground, the guild's ledgers burn, debts dissolve, and the enforcers kneel to a court that no longer holds them. Lena, seen fully for the first time, plants the prophecy book like a seed. Emotional beat: resolution—belonging chosen, survival's price finally named and paid.
